WITH q AS (
  SELECT query AS qt
  FROM query_texts
  WHERE CAST(queryid AS VARCHAR) = (${query_id:sqlstring}) AND regexp_full_match(dbname, ('${db_name:regex}'))
  ORDER BY last_seen DESC, dbname
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT qt AS "Query text" FROM q
UNION ALL
SELECT '(query text not yet collected for this queryid; pgai-mon stores it with its next pg_stat_statements snapshot)'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM q)

WITH w AS (
  SELECT list_transform((['wait_event_type', 'wait_event']), lambda k: coalesce(labels[k], '')) AS k,
         coalesce(labels['instance'], '') AS instance, t, sum(value) AS v
  FROM prom_sum_over_time('pgwatch_wait_events_total',
         [['cluster','=',(${cluster_name:sqlstring})],['node_name','=',(${node_name:sqlstring})],['datname','=~',('${db_name:regex}')]]
         || CASE ('query')
              WHEN 'wet' THEN [['wait_event_type','=~',('')]]
              WHEN 'wet_we' THEN [['wait_event_type','=~',('')],['wait_event','=~',('')]]
              WHEN 'query' THEN [['query_id','=',(${query_id:sqlstring})],['query_id','!=','']]
              ELSE CAST([] AS VARCHAR[][]) END,
         (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))
  GROUP BY ALL
), filled AS (       -- default 0
  SELECT d.k, d.instance, g.t, coalesce(w.v, 0) AS v
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT k, instance FROM w) d
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(range((CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)) + 1, (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))) AS t) g
  LEFT JOIN w ON w.k = d.k AND w.instance = d.instance AND w.t = g.t
), up AS (
  SELECT coalesce(labels['instance'], '') AS instance, t, sum(value) AS n
  FROM prom_sum_over_time('up', [['job','=','pgwatch-prometheus']],
         (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)))
  GROUP BY ALL HAVING sum(value) > 0
), r AS (
  SELECT k, t, sum(v / n) AS value FROM filled JOIN up USING (instance, t) GROUP BY ALL
), names AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k, map_from_entries(list_filter(
           list_transform(range(1, len(k) + 1), lambda i: {'k': (['wait_event_type', 'wait_event'])[i], 'v': k[i]}),
           lambda e: e.v <> '')) AS labels
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT k FROM w)
), legend_names AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT q.k AS __key, coalesce(q.labels['wait_event_type'], '') || ':' || coalesce(q.labels['wait_event'], '') AS __series FROM names q
), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT __key, __series || CASE WHEN row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY __series ORDER BY __key) > 1 THEN ' ' || repeat('#', 1 + max(length(regexp_extract(__series, ' (#+)[0-9]+$', 1))) OVER ()) || row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY __series ORDER BY __key) ELSE '' END AS __series FROM legend_names
)
SELECT CAST(r.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(r.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, n.__series
FROM r JOIN rendered n ON r.k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.__key
WHERE r.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(r.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time
